name: TOTP Sign-In
summary: Completes a password-issued MFA challenge with TOTP and adapts the accepted proof to either the web session path or the mobile token path.

sourceReferences.note: AuthenticateWithTotpAsync and AuthenticateWithTotpTokenAsync both require challenge-aware request contracts and adapt only accepted TOTP proof into browser or token session completion.
The shared typed handler requires a password-issued MFA challenge bound to the same durable user, verifies TOTP as step-up, and consumes the challenge only after successful proof.
The short-lived MFA challenge is the server-side bridge between accepted primary-password proof and the second-factor continuation.
